Name: Pahath-moab
Summary: Head of a large returning family (2,812 in Ezra 2:6); his sons returned with Ezra, built the wall, and sealed the covenant (Ezra 2:6, 8:4, 10:30; Nehemiah 3:11, 7:11, 10:14).
KeyVerses: Ezra 2:6; Ezra 8:4; Ezra 10:30; Nehemiah 3:11; Nehemiah 7:11; Nehemiah 10:14
LifeLesson: A family's faithfulness can span the return, the building, and the renewal.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
